items.expected_conclusion: Within the investigated model and validation scope, the connected zwitterion-mediated route is consistent with a high initial barrier followed by a descending profile to a thermodynamically favourable cyclopentenone endpoint; the conclusion is not a claim of unique experimental mechanism.
